<?php
// 1) Verifier error
if ($_FILES['avatar']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) die('Erreur');

// 2) Taille
if ($_FILES['avatar']['size'] > 5*1024*1024) die('Trop gros');

// 3) Extension
$ext = strtolower(pathinfo($_FILES['avatar']['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
if (!in_array($ext, ['jpg','png'], true)) die('Format');

// 4) Dossier recursif
$dir = __DIR__ . '/uploads/' . date('Y/m/d');
if (!is_dir($dir)) mkdir($dir, 0777, true);

// 5) Nom unique + move_uploaded_file
$new = uniqid('av_', true) . '.' . $ext;
if (move_uploaded_file($_FILES['avatar']['tmp_name'], "$dir/$new")) {
    echo 'Sauve';
}
